---
id: beb8a6e9-be9c-580c-8fa2-d802c22b620a
name: Procedural studio
description: Use the linked Origin kit to make a procedural still, retain depth, and check a factual caption.
---
Discover the granted tools with inferay_tools list. Use their IDs and input schemas.

1. Draft a short factual Instagram caption describing the composition. Avoid unsupported performance claims, calls to action, hype and invented outcomes.
2. Call Check caption with the exact proposed text. Read its findings. If it fails, revise the text and call the checker again. Do not call a failed check a pass.
3. Call Render procedural still. Choose pillar-stack, pebble-ring or arch-glow. Supply a seed, scale and samples explicitly. Start with scale 0.1 and 2 samples for a preview; production scale and samples require a separate reviewed task.
4. Retain the beauty and depth PNGs returned by the tool. Inspect the beauty image if your available tools support it. State when you have not visually inspected it. A valid PNG is not a brand-quality judgment.
5. Report the exact caption, checker outcome, scene and seed, and links to the generated artifacts. Report failures and partial outputs plainly.

The required-tool rule checks whether each declared tool's latest attempt passed; it does not prove that a caption describes an image or that brand quality has been approved. Never weaken a check, edit the kit, bypass the sandbox, or claim publication. These tools have no posting credentials or network permission.
